title: SelfDet Runtime: A Comparative Pilot of Decision Architectures under Conflicting Goals, Constraints, and Delegated Authority
subtitle: A proposed comparative simulation pilot of decision architectures under conflicting goals, constraints and delegated authority.
audience: Researchers and contributors interested in independent, open collaboration.
lede: SelfDet Runtime is a pre-implementation research proposal by Garegin Miskaryan. The proposed bounded simulation pilot compares LLM-only, rules-only and an integrated controller on task completion, constraint violations, uncertainty and delegated authority. The project seeks methodological reviewers, simulation engineers and independent evaluators. A protocol, matched controls and preregistered evaluation would precede claims of benefit; no implemented system or validated result is claimed. Listing invites voluntary collaboration and does not establish funding, endorsement or an institutional partnership.

sections.heading: Participate
sections.body: Discuss the proposed scope, review available artifacts and agree on a bounded first milestone with the project facilitator. Progress and open questions can be shared through the Institute's project forms.
